prompt:
GAME BACKGROUND, WIDE 16:9 LANDSCAPE, seen in FIRST PERSON from the eyes of a short man standing (camera at about 1.55 m, looking straight ahead, natural perspective, no fisheye). NO people and NO animals anywhere in the image (characters are added later as separate layers). Detailed clean pixel art, larger flat colour areas, little texture noise. No text, no letters, no logos.
The kitchen of an old village house in rural Oltenia, Romania, on a rainy late-autumn evening. Low ceiling with wooden beams, walls painted pale green with a lime-washed lower band, a worn linoleum floor with a brown pattern. LEFT: the old wooden front door (closed), a coat hook with a rain jacket, rubber boots. CENTRE: an EMPTY floor area in the middle of the room (left clear for a person and a washing machine). RIGHT: a table with an oilcloth tablecloth with a fruit pattern, two wooden chairs, an old enamel gas stove with a pot, a small window over the table with rain streaks on the dark glass and a lace curtain. TOP RIGHT on the wall: an Orthodox icon with a small oil lamp (candelă) under it, glowing. A single bare light bulb hanging from the ceiling gives warm yellow light; cold blue night light from the window. Details: a wall calendar with a blank picture, a radio on a shelf, braided garlic, a plastic water bottle. Cosy, shabby, real.
